name: Userlist
line: SaaS lifecycle messaging, newsletters and API-triggered app email.

free.text: 14 days, card required; send cap not published

cells.newsletters: Yes, for recipients who explicitly signed up
cells.api: Yes, Push API for transactional messages; no SMTP
